news.title: Mish Designs Limited announced a financing transaction
news.body: Mish Designs Limited announced a private placement to issue 263,160 equity shares and 245,615 convertible warrant on May 8, 2026. Transaction involve participation of Kaushal Goenka for 87,720 share, Tapan Shah for 87,720 shares, Bhawna Goenka for 157,895 warrant and other investors. Transaction is approved by board of directors and is subject to approval of  regulatory / statutory authorities and the shareholders of the Company.  Each warrant convertible into, or exchangeable for, 1 (one) fully paid-up Equity Share of the Company and may be exercised in one or more tranches during the period commencing from the date of allotment of the Warrants until expiry of 18 (Eighteen) months.
